parts.html: The K-11 standard model is a contemporary straight kitchen in a restrained gray palette with stone-effect decor and simple geometry.
Its main feature is the stone-effect finish: it gives the kitchen the expressiveness of a natural texture without disrupting its unity. Gray pairs easily with light walls, wood, and metal.
All the work zones run along one wall — convenient for apartments and open-plan kitchen and living rooms where you need to keep the space open.
The upper cabinets open upward on FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanisms, the doors close smoothly on Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges, and the cargo pull-out conveniently stores food and utensils.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
We make the K-11 to fit your kitchen’s dimensions and layout — with the cabinet sizes you need and materials of your choice.
